intro: Chabad of Lamorinda has no membership dues. Everything we do, from Shabbat dinners to the preschool, Hebrew school, holiday programs and help in times of need, is made possible by the generosity of our community. Every gift is tax deductible.

funds.name: Children's Programs
funds.text: Hebrew School, CKids and children's events.

funds.name: Holiday Programs
funds.text: Rosh Hashanah to Passover, for the whole community.

funds.name: Bay Kosher Market
funds.text: Keeping kosher food available in the East Bay.

funds.name: Building Campaign
funds.text: A permanent home for Jewish life in Lamorinda.

building.text: Help build a permanent home for Jewish life in Lafayette, Moraga and Orinda. Every level of giving is recognized.

ways.name: Venmo
ways.text: Send your gift on Venmo to @CHABAD-LAMORINDA.

ways.name: Zelle
ways.text: Send your gift by Zelle. Call or email us for our Zelle address.

ways.name: Check
ways.text: Make your check payable to Chabad of Lamorinda and mail it to 3477 Golden Gate Way, Lafayette, CA 94549.

ways.name: Donor Advised Fund
ways.text: Recommend a grant from your donor advised fund to Chabad of Lamorinda, tax ID 47-4642750.

ways.name: Stock
ways.text: Gifts of appreciated stock are welcome and can save you capital gains tax. Call or email us for transfer instructions.

ways.name: Cryptocurrency
ways.text: Cryptocurrency gifts are welcome. Call or email us for details.

ways.name: Wire or ACH
ways.text: Call or email us for wire and ACH details.
